events.verdict: Mitchell (TOR) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Sasser (DET) as the steal occurs. Any additional contact is deemed incidental.
Duren (DET) fails to clear the lane within 3 seconds after stepping into the paint.
Barrett (TOR) defends the post play and brings his arm down, legally contesting and blocking Harris's (DET) shot attempt.
Following the blocked shot, the ball bounces out of bound at the conclusion of the shot clock. A 24 second violation is correctly whistled.
Duren (DET) maintains a legal guarding position and cleanly dislodges the ball from Poltl (TOR) following the entry pass into the post.
While doubling in the post, Cunningham (DET) makes marginal contact with P?ltl's (TOR) arm on the play.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Duren (DET) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Duren reaches in and dislodges the ball from Poltl (TOR), the ball makes no additional contact to Poltl's torso. The ball would remain in the front court and with the Raptors inbounding.
Duren (DET) reroutes Poltl (TOR) into his teammate, Barrett (TOR), the contact affects his driving shot attempt.
Agbaji (TOR) defends the drive and makes marginal contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm as the pair come together.
Barrett (TOR) avoids making body contact with Harris (DET) as he contests the jump shot attempt.
Mitchell (TOR) makes incidental contact with Moore Jr. (DET) while in pursuit of the loose ball. Moore collects the loose ball and a timeout is recognized.
Agbaji (TOR) commits a take foul on Beasley (DET) in the backcourt.
Mitchell (TOR) commits a take foul on Ivey (DET) following the inbound pass.
Poltl (TOR) and Ivey (DET) make mutual marginal contact during the screen, as Poltl retreats into Ivey while Ivey briefly pulls Poltl in an attempt to slingshot around the play.
Ivey (DET) legally contests Dick's (TOR) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
